source_corrections: Pereira Theorem 6.1's displayed statement omits numerical triviality of the foliation canonical bundle; section 6 immediately surrounding the statement and its argument supply this hypothesis. 0BHA retains it explicitly.
Markman section 11 requires finite-group quotient descent; the original transformed sheaf is not asserted to be semiregular without this step.
Pereira Theorem 7.2's locally free tangent sheaf is not identified with a regular foliation in the non-algebraically-integrable case.
